areas.inicio: Today at a glance: showings, leads waiting on a reply, rent due and which listing moved.
areas.inmuebles: Your full portfolio: photos, 3D tours, price, location and the status of every listing.
areas.prospectos: The funnel, from "just messaged" to "signed": who owns it, how fast you replied and why it fell through.
areas.visitas: The showing schedule and key control: who shows what, at what time and who has the keys.
areas.rentas: Lease agreements: tenant, guarantor, deposit, term and the rent increase rule.
areas.cobranza: This month's charges, payments received with their receipt, security deposits and property expenses.
areas.propietarios: Your owner book and their exclusives: who you have a signed agreement with, and until when.
areas.comisiones: Closed deals and how the commission splits: listing side, selling side, office and who already got paid.
areas.equipo: Your agents, their permissions and your offices: who sees what and who can touch the money.
areas.reportes: The numbers: what comes in, where leads come from and which listings get stuck.
areas.mi-web: Your public site with your live portfolio, at your own address, without paying anyone to list.
areas.portales: The feed of your listings for outside publishing, and the status of each one on each portal.
areas.whatsapp: Every conversation in one place: who asked about which property and who answered.
areas.calculadoras: Transfer tax, mortgage payment and rental yield, with parameters that update every year.
areas.suscripcion: Your plan, what it includes, your storage allowance and your payment method.
areas.configuracion: Your account details: name, real estate license, address and how clients see you.
areas.soporte: Message the DaleControl team when something breaks or doesn't add up.
